summary: Frontend-only visual regression test of the global public Footer heading wrap fix. Verified on desktop (1920x900) and mobile (390x900) across public pages. All 4 heading lines render correctly, no overflow, no glyph overlap. All expected footer elements (WhatsApp, email, Instagram, Facebook, YouTube, TikTok, 'Somos más que un Torneo', copyright) render without regressions. Footer conditional rendering (!hideChrome) works as intended.

desktop_1920x900.note: 'TOMAMOS UN' stays on a single line thanks to lg:whitespace-nowrap + lg:grid-cols-[3fr_2fr]. '¿' rendered as rotated '?' via renderPlaneCrash with no overlap on following letter.

footer_presence_by_route./login: true (LoginRedirect redirects to '/', so footer is expected on final URL - not a bug)

console_errors: Only 6x 401 (unauthenticated /me endpoint calls) — pre-existing, unrelated to footer fix.
critical_code_review_comments:
Footer.jsx: heading fallback text uses '¿Y SI NOS
TOMAMOS UN
CAFECITO
JUNTOS?' matching the MongoDB stored value — good defensive default.

The condition `hideChrome = path.startsWith('/login') || path.startsWith('/registro')` correctly hides footer on /registro; /login route is a LoginRedirect that navigates to '/' immediately, so footer appears on Home (expected behavior, not a regression).
context_for_next_testing_agent: Footer heading wrap fix is verified working on both desktop and mobile. Uses lg:grid-cols-[3fr_2fr] with fontSize clamp(30px,4.2vw,64px) + lg:whitespace-nowrap on each line span. Rendered as 4 distinct visual lines. No overflow. Fix is stable.
